summary: Adds GA support for agent pools, allowing isolated groups of agents to act as source or sink endpoints in transfer jobs for concurrent multi-file-system and multi-data-center transfers; Storage Transfer Service now offers agent pool support, allowing isolated groups of agents to act as source or sink entities for concurrent transfers across multiple data centers and filesystems.
extended_definition: Adds GA support for agent pools, allowing isolated groups of agents to act as source or sink endpoints in transfer jobs for concurrent multi-file-system and multi-data-center transfers; Storage Transfer Service now offers agent pool support, allowing isolated groups of agents to act as source or sink entities for concurrent transfers across multiple data centers and filesystems.
